step12_scaling_decision: Focused sensitivity on the two variables that actually move this credit (market value of the listed investment portfolio; the electricity-duty litigation outcome) plus the real-estate segment, INSTEAD of a full 5-yr 3-statement model. Reason: total debt is Rs 10.64 crore against Rs 3,885.89 crore of quoted investments and a net CASH position of Rs 81.38 crore - no plausible revenue/margin/capex path changes the debt-servicing conclusion, so a 3-statement projection would model variables that cannot bind. What CAN bind is the portfolio's marked-to-market value (down 33% from its FY2024 peak) and an unascertainable litigation interest exposure - neither of which a 3-statement model captures. Also: no quarterly results and no sector-assumptions document were supplied. See Alembic_Limited_Sensitivity_Model_31Aug2026.md. Recorded 31-Aug-2026 per failure mode 35.
